revision: v8 (Fusion 360: MotorMount_v12 inward-pod planar slab; lambda=33 wheel contact latitude; plan-B inward motor storage; Frame_L1 tail clearance holes 3x Ø48; 3D-print optimized)

face_count.mount_v12_face_types: Plane(13) + Cylinder(5) のみ(解析面のみ、自由曲面なし)

arrangement: plan-B inward: motor stowed inward-up on the wheel axis (57 deg from horizontal); motor face at s'=16.0 mm on axle coordinate (3.4 mm inside wheel inner end s'=12.6 — M3 ボルト頭スペース確保); Ø4 output shaft inserted from inside into WheelAdapter_v4 through-bore Ø4.2; motor retained solely by 4x M3 face bolts into PCD17 gearbox taps through the slab; slab sweeps over the wheel hub bracket to the Frame_L1 pad; motor tail passes through Ø48 clearance hole in Frame_L1

wheel_geometry.motor_axis_alignment: motor axis parallel to -u33 (dot = 1.0000, all 3 stations); motor face plane at s'=16.0 mm

overlap_mm3.note: TemporaryBRepManager intersection on occurrence-transformed bodies; all pairs 0 mm3 at all 3 stations. Occurrences cleaned: MotorMount_v9/v10/v11 削除済み、現行は MotorMount_v12 x3

hole_alignment.gearbox_taps: motor front face M3 taps at PCD17 (±8.5,0)/(0,±8.5) local, Ø2.5 modeled
hole_alignment.slab_holes: 4x Ø3.5 (print-compensated clearance) coaxial with PCD17 taps on slab face s'=16
hole_alignment.slab_bore: Ø26 (print-compensated from Ø25.8) through bore coaxial with wheel axle (motor insertion)
hole_alignment.pad_holes_vs_frame: 4x Ø4.6 (print-compensated) at (57,±9)/(64,±9) mm match Frame_L1 Ø4.2 holes; pad top flush with L1 bottom
hole_alignment.frame_L1_tail_holes: 3x Ø48 clearance holes for motor tails; L1 net volume 44.1 cm^3; tail tip z≈154 mm rho≈20 mm

clearance_mm.bolt_head_room: wheel inner end s'=12.6 vs slab face s'=16.0 -> 3.4 mm M3 bolt-head room (v11 の2.4mmから改善)
clearance_mm.washer_room_gearbox_bolts: adjacent tap pitch 12 mm; flat face around Ø3.5 holes fits M3 washers
clearance_mm.note: ball_to_motor はモーター軸線と球心の最近接距離(75.6 mm)から球半径50+モーター半径12.2を引いた解析値。隣接ホイール間クリアランスは頂点間近似値

printability.orientation: 側面をベッドに伏せる(スラブ側面 flat)。押出方向 y がベッド鉛直 → サポート材完全不要
printability.hole_orientation: Ø26 ボア・Ø3.5 ×4・Ø4.6 ×4 すべて印刷姿勢で水平穴(形状精度良好)
printability.fillets: 凹角に R4 mm x3 + R2.5 mm x1(応力集中緩和)
printability.hole_compensation: printed clearances: Ø26(nominal Ø25.8), Ø3.5(nominal Ø3.4/M3), Ø4.6(nominal Ø4.5/M4)
printability.material_note: Fusion 上は鋼材質(仮置き)。実印刷は ABS/PETG/PLA 想定; ballbotParameters.m は rhoABS=1050 で体積換算済み

envelope_mm.note: モーターが内側に格納されたため外形はフレーム径支配(λ40 の242.5 mmから縮小)

mass_properties.note: Fusion 360 physicalProperties 計測値。mount_v12 慣性は CG 基準(平行軸減算済み)。ballbotParameters.m へ ABS 密度換算で反映済み

frame_L1.type: M4 screw + nut (clearance holes both sides)
frame_L1.mount_pad_holes: 4x Ø4.6 vertical at (57,±9) and (64,±9) mm, pad top flush with Frame_L1 bottom
frame_L1.frame_holes: 4x Ø4.2 at identical XY positions (verified on Frame_L1 solid)

gearbox_face.type: M3 bolts + washers through mount slab into gearbox taps — sole motor retention
gearbox_face.slab_holes: 4x Ø3.5, coaxial with PCD17 tap pattern

fasteners.clamp_strap: DELETED — no room behind wheel hub bracket; motor retained by face bolts only

assumptions: パッド上面は Frame_L1 下面に面一で接し、M4 ネジ+ナットで締結
モーターは尾部側からスラブ中央 Ø26 ボアへ挿通し、ギアボックス前面タップへ M3 ×4 締結
モーター尾部とエンコーダ配線は Frame_L1 の Ø48 クリアランス穴を通過
ギアボックス前面タップの実寸(径・有効深さ)は実機採寸で確定する
MotorMount_v9/v10/v11 のオカレンスは削除済み。現行は MotorMount_v12 のみ
印刷時はスラブ側面をベッドに伏せる向き(サポート不要)。積層方向強度は実印刷で確認
